title.hr: Dolazak, premještaj, odlazak: kako se ovlasti gomilaju
title.en: Joiner, mover, leaver: how access piles up

concept.hr: Prava dodana i nikad oduzeta gomilaju se, a računi otišlih ostaju otvoreni
concept.en: Rights granted and never taken back pile up; leavers' accounts stay open

summary.hr: Provedi dvije godine odjela s dolascima, premještajima i odlascima; uključi kadrovsku evidenciju, uloge i pregled prava i prati višak prava i otvorene račune.
summary.en: Run two years of a department with joiners, movers and leavers; switch on HR records, roles and an access review, and watch surplus rights and open accounts.
